title: Strategic R&D Manager - Wound Management
description:
Company: B. Braun Avitum Italy S.p.A.
Job Posting Location: Mirandola, Emilia Romagna, Italia
Functional Area: Research and Development
Working Model: Hybrid
Requisition ID: 13330
B. Braun Avitum is a global medical device and therapy partner within the B. Braun Group, with established expertise in Wound Management. Guided by our mission of *Sharing Expertise* , we work in close partnership with healthcare professionals to develop safe, effective, and sustainable wound management solutions that protect and improve the health of patients worldwide. Through scientific excellence, responsible innovation, and long‑term commitment to sustainability, we continuously advance our wound care portfolio. To support our long‑term growth strategy within the business, we are seeking an experienced Strategic R\&D Manager to lead and shape the future development of our wound care portfolio in strong collaboration with our global partners and stakeholders.

  

**Position Summary**

The Strategic R\&D Manager will define and drive the medium‑ to long‑term R\&D strategy for the wound management business, with clear accountability for portfolio management and prioritization. This role sits at the intersection of innovation, clinical needs, and business strategy, translating market and clinical insights into differentiated product platforms and sustainable technology and product roadmaps. The position includes steering internal development activities as well as managing and coordinating third‑party development partners to accelerate innovation and optimize resource allocation. The ideal candidate is a visionary yet hands‑on leader with deep wound care expertise and strong cross‑functional influence across global stakeholders.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy \& Portfolio Development**

* Define, own and implement the R\&D strategy and technology roadmap for wound management with the internal R\&D departments and in close collaboration with Global Marketing (GM), ensuring alignment with portfolio, brand positioning, and customer value propositions
* Lead and align R\&D activities across Sempach and Mirandola, in close collaboration with Project Managers and Strategic Procurement, to secure efficient development, cost competitiveness, supplier integration, and smooth industrialization of innovative wound management solutions.
* Drive portfolio prioritization and investment decisions together with GM, aligning innovation initiatives with business objectives, market attractiveness, and lifecycle management
* Identify unmet users and patients’ needs as well as market trends through structured cooperation with GM, clinical experts, and key opinion leaders

· Build competitive technology positioning and clear differentiation by translating marketing and customer insights into robust product platforms  

**Cross‑Functional Leadership**

* Act as key R\&D partner to Marketing, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, and Operations
* Support M\&A, licensing, or external innovation scouting activities
* Communicate strategy and progress to senior leadership and stakeholders

  

**Team \& Capability Leadership**

* Lead and mentor R\&D scientists and engineers
* Foster a high‑performance, innovation‑driven culture
* Build core competencies in wound management technologies, materials, and systems
* Actively promote “Sharing Expertise” by collaborating with and transferring knowledge to other business divisions across the B. Braun Group, leveraging synergies and best practices to accelerate innovation and portfolio value

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s or PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Materials Science, Life Sciences, Natural Sciences or related field
* 5\+ years of R\&D experience in medical devices
* Strong background in wound management / wound healing products
* Proven experience in R\&D strategy, portfolio management, or innovation leadership
* Solid understanding of ISO 13485, MDR / FDA requirements
* Fluency in English; German language is a plus

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile (“Winning Profile”)**

* Strategic thinker with strong execution capability
* Deep scientific and technical credibility in wound care
* Business‑oriented mindset with customer and patient focus
* Comfortable influencing at executive level
* Resilient, curious, and passionate about innovation

  

**What We Offer**

* High‑impact strategic role in a growing global business
* Competitive executive compensation package
* Opportunity to shape future wound care technologies
* International exposure and career growth potential
* Collaborative, science‑driven culture

  

 Compensation details: Salary range: € 70\.000 \- € 80\.000 Gross Annual Salary (RAL) \+ MBO.
The aforementioned range represents the estimated remuneration for the position. The final gross annual salary will be determined based on the selected candidate's experience and skills, in compliance with applicable European regulations on pay transparency and pay equity.
This job posting is open to candidates of all genders (Law 903/77\). Personal data will be processed in accordance with the GDPR (European Regulation 2016/679\).

title: Quality Engineer
description:
As a global medtech company, we are driven by our Vision of changing the trajectory of lives for a new day and our Mission to create ingenious solutions that ignite patient turnarounds. Our relentless commitment to patients and strong legacy of innovation in healthcare are the foundation of our future. If you're looking for a new chance, a new beginning, a new trajectory, LivaNova is where your talent can truly thrive. Join our talented team members worldwide to become a pioneer of tomorrow—because at LivaNova, **we don’t just treat conditions — we aspire to alter the course of lives.**

**Who are we looking for****:**


Are you passionate about quality, product development, and ensuring that healthcare products meet the highest standards of safety and compliance?


We are looking for a **Quality Engineer** to join our Quality team and play a key role in supporting product development, process validation, and quality improvement activities within a highly regulated medical device environment.


In this role, you will work closely with R\&D, Manufacturing, and Quality teams, contributing to the development and maintenance of innovative medical devices while ensuring compliance with international quality and regulatory standards.


This opportunity is ideal for someone with experience in **Product Development, Design Control, and Quality Assurance**, who enjoys solving complex quality challenges and collaborating across functions to drive continuous improvement.

**Your new role****:**

* Partner with R\&D and Engineering teams to define product and process requirements.
* Support Design Control activities throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Review product verification and validation plans, protocols, and reports.
* Review process validation activities to ensure compliance with quality requirements.
* Participate in change impact assessments and evaluate quality implications of product or process changes.
* Coordinate investigations related to verification and validation failures.
* Establish and maintain product quality control plans.
* Identify and lead quality improvement initiatives within manufacturing operations.
* Analyze nonconforming products and support disposition decisions.
* Lead root cause investigations for product and component failures identified during production or through customer complaints.
* Manage CAPA activities and analyze quality trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support suppliers and external manufacturing partners in addressing quality issues and nonconformities.
* Contribute to risk assessments and product safety evaluations, including Health Hazard Assessments (HHA) when required.

**How you'll make an impact****:**

* Ensure that medical devices are developed and manufactured in compliance with regulatory and quality requirements.
* Act as the Quality representative within cross\-functional product development projects.
* Support the successful launch and maintenance of products by identifying risks and quality concerns early in the process.
* Improve manufacturing quality performance through structured problem solving and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Drive investigations and corrective actions that enhance product reliability and patient safety.
* Contribute to maintaining a strong Quality Culture across the organization.

**About you****:**

* Degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Physics, or another scientific discipline.
* 1\-3 years of experience within Quality Assurance in the Medical Device or Pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience supporting product design and development activities.
* Good understanding of Product Development Processes and Design Control principles.
* Knowledge of ISO 13485 and Quality Management Systems.
* Understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* Experience with validation activities, CAPA management, nonconformance investigations, and root cause analysis is considered a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

**What you will find****:**

* The opportunity to work on products that directly impact patients’ lives.
* Exposure to the full product development lifecycle within the medical device industry.
* A collaborative environment where Quality, R\&D, and Manufacturing work closely together.
* The chance to develop expertise in Design Quality, Validation, Risk Management, CAPA, and Product Development Processes.
* Continuous learning opportunities within a highly regulated and innovation\-driven industry.
* A dynamic and international environment focused on quality, compliance, and continuous improvement.
* Career growth opportunities within Quality Engineering and Product Development functions.

**Location****:** Mirandola, Italy

 **WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:**

* National Collective Bargaining Agreement: CCNL Gomma Plastica
* Level: A/C
* Base Salary range: € 31\.000 – € 50\.000
* Bonus: 0\-5%


Actual compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

**We offer a competitive benefits package including:**

* Flexible working options.
* Medical insurance.
* Pension scheme.
* Employee stock purchase plan.
* Global recognition programme.
* Additional benefits (e.g. meal vouchers, flexible benefits, local bonuses) may apply depending on location.


In addition to providing you with a supportive, inclusive and collaborative environment where you will feel empowered to take ownership and drive meaningful change, we will reward you with a competitive package, including financial and wellbeing benefits.


If you like the sound of the above and feel energised by the idea of joining a great brand at a moment of exciting expansion, please apply now. We look forward to hearing from you!

**Welcome to impact. Welcome to innovation. Welcome to your new life.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

title: Founding Simulation Engineer - Multibody & FEM
description:
##### ***Founding Simulation Engineer \- Multibody \& FEM***

##### **Compensation: €50,000 \- €60,000 \+ Equity**

##### **Bologna, Italy. Full\-time.**

**Who we are**
--------------


Liablix is an innovative startup transforming how road accidents are reconstructed and analyzed. Today, claims management is slow, opaque, and prone to fraud. We want to make it precise, fast, and automated; powered by AI.


We work at the intersection of computer vision, 3D reconstruction, and generative models to analyze vehicle damages, crash dynamics, and liability. It's a massive market, and we're convinced that the next insurtech unicorn will be born here.


We're VC\-backed by top international funds that strongly believe in our vision and support our rapid growth.


Reconstructing an accident means simulating it. We're looking for a Founding Simulation Engineer to build our 3D multibody and FEM simulation engine for accident reconstruction: the physics core that turns images and evidence into crash dynamics, for every kind of vehicle on the road. Your mission is simple to state and very hard to achieve: make our simulations the most realistic ever seen in this industry.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design and build our 3D multibody dynamics engine for vehicle motion, impact, and post\-impact trajectories.
* Develop FEM models of structural deformation to link vehicle damage to impact energy, speed, and direction.
* Extend the engine to multiple vehicle classes: cars, motorcycles, trucks, bicycles, and pedestrians.
* Validate against real\-world crash data (NHTSA, Euro NCAP, real claims from our platform) and iterate until the results are court\-grade.
* Integrate the simulation core with our 3D reconstruction and AI pipeline, so scene geometry and damage estimates feed the physics directly.
* Work side by side with one of the top experts in car accident simulation, who will help you turn decades of domain knowledge into software.
* Optimize for speed: reconstructions must run in minutes on cloud infrastructure, not overnight on a workstation.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Background in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or Applied Mathematics (MSc or PhD).
* Strong experience with multibody dynamics and/or FEM crash simulation (LS\-DYNA, PAM\-CRASH, Abaqus, Adams, Project Chrono, or your own solvers).
* Solid grasp of contact and impact mechanics, vehicle dynamics, and numerical methods (time integration, stiff systems, convergence).
* Good programming skills in C\+\+ and/or Python; you can turn a paper into working code.
* Experience with accident reconstruction, biomechanics, or automotive safety is a strong plus.
* Entrepreneurial mindset: eager to build something that scales globally, not just a research prototype.
* Being a genius is a strong plus.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* A pivotal role: you'll be among the first 10 team members and shape both the technology and culture of Liablix.
* Competitive salary (RAL): €50,000 \- €60,000 annually.
* Equity: meaningful stake (indicatively 0\.3% \- 0\.5%) in stock options with standard 4\-year vesting (1\-year cliff). Under the Italian innovative\-startup regime, options are exempt from income tax and you only pay capital gains when you sell.
* Salary growth built in: compensation is reviewed at the next funding round and upon hitting company milestones, plus a performance bonus.
* Standard benefits: private health insurance, training and conference budget, flexibility on remote days (HQ in Bologna), periodic team retreats, personal financial advisor.
* Accelerated growth: your name will be tied to one of the most ambitious AI startups in Europe.

**Culture Fit**
---------------


We’re a fit if:

* You're an A\-player who wants to work with other A\-players.
* You take ownership and thrive in fast\-moving environments.
* You want to build something big and put all of yourself into it.


We’re not a fit if:

* You prefer predictable corporate roles with predefined tasks.
* You're not ready to commit 100% to an early\-stage journey.
* You're only interested in running existing solvers, not building new ones.

**Why join us**
---------------


Tired of simulations that end up in a report nobody reads? Here your solver decides real cases: every model you build reconstructs real accidents and settles real claims, and the accuracy bar you set becomes the standard for an entire industry.


We're not looking for “employees.” We're looking for co\-creators of Liablix's future.


You didn't buy Bitcoin in 2009, but you joined Liablix in 2026\. Everyone says they want to join a unicorn early. Few actually do.

title: Accident Reconstruction Specialist - Junior
description:
##### **Accident Reconstruction Specialist \- Junior**

##### ***Remote*** **•** ***Full time*** **•** **€21,000 – €23,000 annually**

**Who we are**
--------------


Liablix is an innovative startup transforming the way road accidents are reconstructed and analyzed. Today, claims handling is often slow, opaque, and vulnerable to errors or fraud. Our mission is to make it precise, fast, and automated through Artificial Intelligence.


We are backed by leading international investment funds that strongly believe in our vision and support our growth.


We are in the early stages of development and are looking for an Accident Reconstruction Specialist, one of the key figures who will directly contribute to the technical quality of our product and to the creation of a new software category in the insurance and accident analysis sector.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Digital accident reconstruction in a completely new way: you will use the Liablix platform to reconstruct road accident dynamics through advanced software tools.
* Technical analysis: you will assess damage compatibility, impact points, accident kinematics, and consistency between the reported version of events and the available evidence.
* Output validation: you will supervise and validate the results generated by the platform, ensuring technical accuracy, reliability, and quality control, while contributing to the continuous improvement of AI models.
* Cross\-team collaboration: you will work closely with AI and software development teams, reporting bugs, anomalies, and new features that can continuously improve the platform.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------


We are looking for a junior profile motivated to grow professionally in an environment that combines technical expertise with advanced digital tools.


Direct experience in road accident reconstruction is not required. Above all, we are looking for someone eager to be trained, willing to learn a highly specialized profession that is rapidly evolving.

* Technical or academic background, such as ITIS diploma, mechanical or industrial technician qualification, mechatronics, automotive studies, degree in mechanical engineering, or equivalent paths.
* A mindset oriented toward mechanics, technical analysis, and vehicle engineering. Knowledge of vehicle mechanics, crash dynamics, and technical reading skills are highly appreciated.
* Strong analytical thinking, precision, and logical reasoning are essential.
* Good familiarity with computers, software, and digital tools is required, along with curiosity toward innovative technologies, Artificial Intelligence, and new ways of working.
* Previous experience or background as an insurance adjuster, accident reconstruction specialist, or similar roles will be considered a plus.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* A central role: you will join among the first members of the team dedicated to road accident reconstruction and directly contribute both to product growth and company culture. As the team expands, you will have broad professional growth opportunities.
* Transparent salary: €21,000 – €23,000 gross annual salary.
* Performance bonus and salary review upon reaching initial milestones.
* Career acceleration: your work will have a direct impact on product evolution and on the future of the industry.

**Culture Fit**
---------------


We’re a fit if:

* You enjoy taking responsibility and helping build something new from scratch, as part of an ambitious project.
* You are passionate about technical topics, mechanics, innovation, and new technologies.
* You want to train in this sector and contribute to its digital evolution.


We’re not a fit if:

* You are not curious and unwilling to continuously learn and improve.
* You do not like taking ownership of your work and having real responsibilities.
* You are looking for slow, highly hierarchical, or low\-dynamic environments, far from the pace of a startup.

**Why join us**
---------------


Tired of repetitive technical work in traditional environments? Here, you will help build the most advanced software in the world for road accident reconstruction, seeing your work immediately turn into a real product.


You will work on something completely new, something no one has ever built before in this sector, contributing firsthand to its growth and development. You will do so alongside some of the best national professionals in the field of accident reconstruction.
